prompts.world: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game environment background, NOT a concept mockup, no interface. Create a beautifully hand-painted premium family adventure/puzzle game scene for Akari Quest, a Japanese elementary science game. Landscape 3:2, high resolution. The upper 45% shows a charming small hillside village at blue hour, three richly detailed cozy cottages with slate teal roofs, plaster walls, timber, rounded foliage, distant layered mountains, a soft violet sky and a tiny crescent. All windows are dark blue glass, ALL electric lamps OFF, absolutely no yellow windows, no artificial illumination. Subtle remaining sunset and cool moonlight provide visibility. Foreground bottom 55% is one very broad EMPTY honey walnut craftsman's workbench, viewed from gently elevated front, beautifully painted wood grain, beveled edge and small brass corner hardware. The full flat tabletop from x=4% to96%, y=49% to92% must be empty unobstructed usable play space: no tools, no wires, no batteries, no bulbs, no books or foliage on the tabletop. Rich but controlled painterly detail, sculpted forms and ambient occlusion, warm wood against atmospheric midnight teal, soft luminous edge highlights, professional polished 2D mobile game background with clean silhouettes and physical depth. Village behind the table, table in front; straight-on camera consistent with items later placed on it. No characters, no text, no symbols, no UI, no border, no watermark. The actual output will be directly used in the working game at 400x250 coordinates and enlarged on desktop, so make the table's uncluttered central playing field readable even when downscaled.
